title: Mastermind: code-breaking with structured feedback pegs
description: 2 players (codemaker/codebreaker), 4-peg code from 6 colors. Codemaker sets hidden code, codebreaker guesses. Feedback: black peg = right color right position, white peg = right color wrong position. 10-12 guesses to crack the code. Demonstrates information-theoretic deduction with structured feedback. Imperfect information, server_only for hidden code.
